step1.title: Step 1
step1.detail: Admin posts a link, advertiser sees smart calendar of available slots.

step2.title: Step 2
step2.detail: Payment in a few clicks. Money is held in system (Escrow), not sent directly to admin.

step3.title: Step 3
step3.detail: Bot publishes the post and transfers money to admin only after successful verification.

result.title: Result
result.detail: Money is held in escrow until post is published and verified, then released to admin's withdrawable balance.

guarantee1.title: Smart Monitoring
guarantee1.description: Bot checks post every N minutes. If admin deletes it on 23rd hour - money returns to buyer.

guarantee2.title: Auto-deletion
guarantee2.description: After 24 hours bot automatically deletes ad post and transfers money to admin. No alarms needed.

guarantee3.title: 3 Strikes Rule
guarantee3.description: For fraud attempts (link substitution, early deletion) - instant refund to buyer. 3 strikes = permanent ban of admin and channels.

guarantee4.title: Absolutely Legal
guarantee4.description: Bot works through official Telegram API only in channels where admin added it. Zero risk of TG bans.

feature1.title: Channel Marketplace
feature1.description: Convenient catalog of channels organized by genres, ratings and reviews
feature1.detail: Inside the bot there will be a marketplace with channels divided by genres, reviews and other criteria for convenient search and selection.

feature2.title: Smart Calendar
feature2.description: Automated slot grid generation for admins
feature2.detail: Set weekly rules, add exceptions in clicks. Soft booking system with 15-minute reservation windows.

feature3.title: Escrow Protection
feature3.description: Automated payment security for both parties
feature3.detail: Funds held until publication verified. 24-hour monitoring ensures compliance before releasing payments to admin.

feature4.title: Double Moderation
feature4.description: Posts go through channel owner moderation, then manager review
feature4.detail: Channel owners can reject posts with reason. For severe violations, the buyer will be blocked after manager verification.

economics.title: Transparent Economics
economics.subtitle: Fair and clear commissions
economics.deposit: 1.5% service commission (in addition to payment system fees). Detailed invoice with all commissions breakdown will be provided
economics.service_fee: 5% service commission (charged only if post successfully published and stayed up for required time)
economics.min_withdrawal: configurable auto-withdrawal triggers or manual withdrawal
economics.withdrawal_methods: TON, USDT (TRC-20/BEP-20) and other integrated systems
economics.withdrawal_speed: from instant (crypto) to 24 hours (manual moderation for large amounts)

security.title: Security & Technology
security.transaction_layer: PostgreSQL stores complete balance change history with unique IDs and audit logs
security.payment_queues: Redis/Celery for processing withdrawal requests and payment API interactions
security.security_features: Two-factor verification for withdrawal details changes and admin violation tracking system

q1.question: Why top up balance instead of paying directly?
q1.answer: It's faster. If admin rejects your post (pre-moderation), money instantly returns to your app balance, and you can immediately buy placement in another channel without waiting for bank/blockchain refunds.

q2.question: How to withdraw earnings?
q2.answer: In 'My Channels / Wallet' section, specify amount and choose available method (crypto at launch). When minimum threshold is reached, request goes to processing.

q3.question: What if I topped up balance but changed my mind about buying ads?
q3.answer: You can request withdrawal back to your wallet minus payment system fees.
